name: Tourist Entry Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Algeria has very few visa-exempt nationalities and, as of 2026, remains predominantly consulate-based rather than offering a fully operational e-visa system for most nationalities -- online appointment scheduling exists but physical dossier submission is still typically required. A short-term tourist visa for French nationals (as a reference case) runs close to EUR 100 for adults, with a separate non-refundable processing fee, for a stay generally under 90 days.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a tourist visa in person or via appointment at an Algerian consulate.

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Algeria). STATUS: DRAFT -- the general tourist-visa hard requirement is sourced only to a private travel-guide site, tier 4; Algeria's own Ministry of Interior page on foreign-resident cards (interieur.gov.dz) and Foreign Ministry PDF guide were both located by URL but returned SSL/certificate errors on every fetch attempt in this build -- a recurring, disclosed access gap worth a dedicated retry. DISTINCT, NARROWER FINDING NOT MODELED AS THE MAIN ROUTE: a separate, government-confirmed (tier 1) visa-exemption scheme lets members of the ALGERIAN DIASPORA holding foreign passports enter and exit visa-free -- extended through 31 December 2026 by presidential directive. This is not a general tourist-visa exemption for ordinary foreign nationals and is disclosed here as a distinct, narrower mechanism rather than conflated with the main route. No named list of ordinary visa-exempt nationalities was confirmed in this build.
